entities.name: Roman Jebavý
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Roman Jebavý is a Czech former professional tennis player. He is a doubles specialist who has won four ATP Tour doubles titles. He reached a career-high ranking in doubles of World No. 43 on 4 March 2019.
